info.title: Zoho Mail Universal API
info.description: Send, receive, and organize business email conversations

put.description: Applies labels to emails in Zoho Mail.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

messageId[].description: One or more message IDs to apply labels to.

threadId[].description: One or more thread IDs to apply labels to instead of specific message IDs.

labelId[].description: One or more label IDs to apply to the selected emails.

isFolderSpecific.description: Whether this label update should be restricted to a specific folder.

folderId.description: Folder ID used when Folder Specific is true.

isArchive.description: Whether archived emails should also be included in this label action.

code.description: Zoho Mail status code for the label update request.

description.description: Zoho Mail status description for the label update request.

post.description: Replies to an email in Zoho Mail.
